description: This Dart source file defines a class `AppTheme` that encapsulates theme colors and a light theme configuration for a Flutter app. It includes static color constants corresponding to the app's branding and style, and provides a method to retrieve a `ThemeData` object with customized color scheme, text styles, and component themes.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing theme colors and a preconfigured light theme for the Flutter app.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Returns a `ThemeData` object configured for a light theme with custom color scheme, app bar, button, drawer, bottom sheet, and text styles.
